VGV AI Flutter Plugin

A [Claude Code][claude code link] plugin that accelerates Flutter & Dart development with best-practices skills from [Very Good Ventures][vgv link].

The plugin lives in plugin/ . Its README covers installation, skills, agents, hooks and MCP tools.

 Repository layout

 Path What it holds 
 ------------------------------------ ----------------------------------------------------------------- 
 plugin/ Everything the plugin loads. This is the folder users install. 
 evals/ The claude plugin eval suite. Not part of the installed plugin. 
 CONTRIBUTING.md How to add or change a skill, and how to test it locally.
